footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Eldorado Gold: includes $3.0M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $17.9M of discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 40-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 37.5% to $1.8B in 2025. Operating income rose 73.4% to $727M, a 40.0% margin.
Net income rose 75.4% to $507M, or $2.47 per share. Operating cash flow was $742.5B and free cash flow $741.6B, versus $655.4B; Eldorado Gold returned $11.3M through buybacks.
sources: Eldorado Gold Corporation Form 40-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
